gaps.sentence: He earns fifty thousand pounds ___ year.
gaps.explanation: 'Fifty thousand a year' — 'a' = per in rates.

gaps.sentence: ___ spaceship travelled for six months before reaching Mars.
gaps.explanation: The spaceship — the one in the story; Mars takes no article.

gaps.sentence: They organized ___ charity concert for flood victims.
gaps.explanation: 'A charity concert' — one of many possible concerts, first mention.

gaps.sentence: The novel had a huge effect on ___ young people of the 1960s.
gaps.explanation: 'The young people of the 1960s' — defined by the of-phrase, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: I live on ___ Baker Street, near the tube station.
gaps.explanation: Street names take no article: Baker Street, Oxford Street.

gaps.sentence: The patient needs ___ operation as soon as possible.
gaps.explanation: 'An operation' — 'operation' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: His wife goes to ___ prison every Sunday to visit him.
gaps.explanation: Here 'the prison' is the building she visits, not the institution of imprisonment.

gaps.sentence: ___ rich variety of birds lives in the Danube delta.
gaps.explanation: A rich variety of… — variety is countable here, first mention.
